label: Faithful quotient presentation of generated values
definition: Presentation A B supplies a Setoid relation on A, an embedding from Quotient relation to B, and injectivity of that embedding. value a is embed (Quotient.mk relation a). Setoid carries reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity; Quotient identifies exactly related representatives; injectivity prevents distinct equivalence classes being collapsed. These are the standard Lean Equivalence/Setoid/Quotient meanings, with Set.range for the image. Representative-independent elimination is embodied by a function defined on Quotient, not asserted by an essence predicate.
note: Analyst mathematical interpretation, attribution deferred. The finite Bool-pair presentation forgets the second coordinate and embeds two classes in Bool + Bool; it has a genuine collision and two distinct outputs. The two right-summand points are outside its range. Arbitrary maps without faithfulness need not have the selected equivalence as their exact kernel. Constitutive essence and metaphysical applicability are not represented or established.
